question: Does floor 88 preserve direction after ablation, or does only an additional direction-bearing witness preserve it?

blinding.boundary: Procedural label concealment prevents UI target cueing; it is not an independent blinded experiment.

preregistered_rules.success_88_self_selects: For every angle variant on floor 88, the landing-only projection preserves two direction records; floors 87 and 89 do not; the result is invariant under direction-label permutation.
preregistered_rules.negative_witness_only: For every floor and angle variant, landing-only and landing-plus-angle each collapse two directions to one record, while an added direction-bearing witness preserves two records.
preregistered_rules.open_result: Any complete non-aborted pattern that satisfies neither success nor negative rule remains OPEN.
abort: labels or expected target direction are exposed before execution
an angle is non-finite or differs from the frozen values
a floor, angle variant or direction mask is missing or duplicated
DAO binding is anything other than NONE
